verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at daytona.io/llms.txt that describes Daytona for agents, plus markdown versions of docs pages (e.g. /docs/en/sandboxes.md) and a machine-readable openapi.json. Daytona also publishes an agent skill with references and patterns for its API, CLI and SDKs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents consume these docs well in practice.
